photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
The New Zealand passport photo size must be 35mm wide by 45mm high. Your head must be a maximum of 36mm and a minimum of 32mm from chin to crown. This is the same size as a standard Australian passport photo. If you are applying for a New Zealand passport online, your photo must also be:

  • In color
  • Between 500KB and 3MB in size
  • Between 900 and 4500 pixels wide
  • Between 1200 and 6000 pixels high

If you are applying for a New Zealand passport on paper, your photo must be:

  • In color
  • Printed on good quality photo paper
  • Trimmed to the correct size (35mm wide by 45mm high)

• Place your baby on a white sheet on your bed, or put it in a baby high chair with a white towel covering the back of the chair.
  • Take away the pacifier, capture the baby’s attention, and try to get a photo with your baby’s mouth closed. Some governments allow the mouth to be slightly open, however, no tongue or teeth can be seen.
  • Make sure your baby’s head is not tilted, and don’t forget that you cannot support the baby by yourself while taking the photo because no other body part can be seen in the photo.
  • In case of selfie, make sure that your hand is stretched fully and stays on the level of shoulders.

You can also take a photo through our website www.smartphon-id.com where we will help you to get a valid photo with the help of our trained experts.

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
• Strong colors that stand out clearly from the background are suitable for a passport photo. Since a light background is required, darker colors are beneficial to increase contrast.
  • Also, make sure your shirt doesn’t show too much skin, as shirtless passport photos are prohibited.
  • Finally, uniforms of any kind are also prohibited on a biometric passport photo.
photo_didentite.titre_accordeon: What to wear for a passport photo?

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon: Not all governments allow glasses because it’s very hard to get it right. Thick frames are forbidden, as well as tinted glass, no reflection can appear, and they must sit correctly. Therefore, those governments who don’t forbid wearing glasses, highly suggest taking them off for the photo.
photo_didentite.titre_accordeon: Can you wear glasses in a passport photo?

photo_didentite.texteAccordeon:
Yes, you can wear makeup in your passport photo.

  • But note that make-up should be light. Don’t put too much eyeshadow on your eyelids.
  • Often glossy lipstick might create a reflection, therefore, better opt for a matte lipstick, if you want to accent your lips.
  • It’s useful also to check that your skin is not oily before taking a photo, as it can create a light reflection, too.
  • Finally, remember that the passport photo must be as natural as possible and must resemble you on a regular day.
